address: 39 Le Hong Phong Street, Phuoc Ninh Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: Set beneath a large tree and only open in the morning, they focus on rice noodles with crab meat in a family-recipe soup that’s rich in umami with a tangy note. Try the Tô Riêu Đặc Biệt, with crab and three types of fish cake. The pork sausage wrapped in banana leaves is also tasty....
